prompts.name: ratel
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent character sprite atlas for a tiny macOS desktop companion.
Create ONE precise 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet. Six equal square cells on a landscape canvas, exactly 1536×1024 if possible. Absolutely transparent alpha background throughout, no checkerboard, no labels, no borders. Each cell contains the SAME honey badger (ratel), same face, proportions and outfit, full body including feet and tail, centered with generous transparent margin and never crossing cell boundaries. Approximately 75% cell height, feet align consistently. Camera fixed, front three-quarter view, facing slightly left.

Style: Disney The Lion Guard / La Garde du Roi Lion, specifically the playful honey badger Bunga, charming 2D television animation cel shading, bold clean outlines, expressive mischievous golden-green eyes, slate blue-grey fur, broad cream-grey crown/back stripe and pale cheeks, dark face markings, short rounded ears, compact stocky honey badger body, broad snout, SHORT honey-badger tail, no bushy raccoon or fox tail. No hoodie, no clothes. Broad cheeky grin, adventurous friendly personality. Keep all six states as clean cartoon drawings, consistent style, readable at 90 pixels. Transparent cutouts only, no scene.
Cell order left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
1 (top left): neutral idle standing, relaxed friendly grin, empty hands.
2 (top middle): actively typing with BOTH paws on a small open silver laptop on a minimal compact desk, focused happy eyes.
3 (top right): second typing frame, EXACT same laptop/desk/body placement as cell 2, one paw slightly lifted to press a key, subtle expression shift.
4 (bottom left): coffee break, holding a ceramic coffee mug close to mouth, content expression.
5 (bottom middle): reading a small open notebook, focused inquisitive expression.
6 (bottom right): work completed, proud delighted grin, a small fist raised in celebration, no computer or desk.
All six are consistent in scale and lighting. Props limited to the stated cells, no shared ground plane, no cast shadow beyond character footprint. Full clean cutouts. No text, no logo, no speech bubble.
